explanation: A title often used for God in the Bible, referring to his sovereignty and authority.
A place or person one seeks protection and safety with. In Psalm 91 it refers to seeking shelter in God.
A feeling of awe and reverence toward God, as well as a healthy fear of his power and justice.
An image used to describe God's protection and care, like a bird protecting its young under its wings.
A symbol for protection and defense. In Psalm 91 it means that God is our protector against dangers and threats.
A situation or thing that can lead to harm or destruction. In Psalm 91 it speaks of being rescued from the traps life may bring.
A powerful and dangerous animal that symbolizes threats and dangers. In Psalm 91 it means that God will protect us from such dangers.
A disease that spreads quickly and causes death and suffering. In Psalm 91 it points to God's protection against sickness and suffering.
To give support, encouragement, and relief to someone who is suffering or worried. In Psalm 91 it means that God will comfort and strengthen us in difficult times.
